description: Monthly mortgage payment breakdown: principal and interest via the amortization formula, plus property tax, homeowner insurance, PMI, and HOA. Use when the user is buying a home and wants the full monthly payment including tax, insurance, PMI and HOA. For a plain loan without housing costs use calculate_loan; for the most they can afford use calculate_affordability. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive mortgage calculator.
